explanation: Encoding replaces each run with its decimal length and character. Decoding accumulates decimal digits until a character arrives, then appends that character the specified number of times. The wrapper checks both directions.
timeComplexity: O(encoded length + decoded length) time using amortized string growth.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space excluding encoded/decoded results.
